entries.label: 2026 federal basic personal amount (maximum)
entries.notes: Credit value = $16,452 x 14% = $2,303.28. Reduces to $14,829 base at net income above $258,482 (phase-down from $181,440).
entries.source_note: CRA; verified 2026-09-27 via Fidelity, Waypoint Budget, Lifemoney, money.ca.

entries.label: 2026 provincial/territorial basic personal amounts
entries.notes: Provincial credits = BPA x lowest provincial rate. PE raised its BPA to $15,000 (announced 2026); NS indexed 1.6%; BC indexed; AB capped 2%; QC indexed 2.05%; MB and PE not indexed for 2026 (PE 15k figure verified via income-tax-estimator research); NL BPA raised to $13,094 effective Jan 1, 2026 (announced Apr 29, 2026; was $11,188); YT BPA mirrors federal maximum $16,452 (base $14,829 for high incomes); territories indexed.
entries.source_note: NL $13,094 verified 2026-09-30 via CRA T4008-NL payroll supplementary tables (canada.ca); YT $16,452 verified 2026-09-30 via 2026 TD1YT and yukon.ca. KPMG tables (June 30, 2026) predate the NL April 2026 budget increase.
